name: Iretis
description: A former Meletian city ruled by King Kedarick VI, destroyed by leonin and claimed by Phenax as a necropolis.

timeline.summary: Leonin destroy Iretis through the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by leonin thanks to the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Locations in Oreskos's surroundings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax makes a pact with Ashiok to lay waste to Iretis in exchange for hiding Ashiok from the other gods.
timeline.quote: Phenax made a pact with the nightmare planeswalker Ashiok

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Cooperation with Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Phenax plague Iretis and the leonin with nightmares until the leonin destroy the polis; Phenax claims it as a necropolis.
timeline.quote: Phenax then claimed Iretis as a new necropolis for his Returned.

citation.text: "Returned", section "Iretis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kedarick writes to his estranged wife Klytessa about the coming peace with the leonin.
timeline.quote: The formal signing with the leonin is in a fortnight.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Outer settlements report impossible monsters whose bodies vanish; Kedarick and Udaen suspect expansionist sabotage.
timeline.quote: The expansionists always want more land, and they see this potential peace as a direct blow to their dreams of expansion.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kedarick remembers the day with Klytessa and baby Lara by the lake and the night after.
timeline.quote: We spent the day at the lake, splashing and walking and talking

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thoros Clawkiller arrives at the throne room and presents the severed head of his nephew, claiming the leonin killed him.
timeline.quote: Thoros put his hand into a satchel and pulled out a head.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thoros demands justice and asks why Kedarick seeks peace with those who kill his people; the king has no answer.
timeline.quote: "Justice for Teralos. Justice for the dead. Justice for the living.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Udaen points out that Thoros stands to lose land if peace holds; Kedarick promises an investigation.
timeline.quote: Thoros was my friend, and my compatriot in battle, but he also stood to lose much if the peace with the leonin held.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thoros attacks Kedarick with a dagger; Udaen trips him with his staff and Thoros's men are slaughtered.
timeline.quote: Udaen was there, interposing his frail body between myself and Thoros, shouting, "For the King!"

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thoros says others told him the king had gone blind in his quest for peace; he seems dazed as if he had not intended the attack.
timeline.quote: They seemed as surprised by the attempt as I had been.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kedarick executes his friend Thoros Clawkiller by beheading him.
timeline.quote: I had my eyes wide open as I passed judgment on Thoros Clawkiller, my friend.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Udaen hands Kedarick a secret letter; Kedarick gives a triumphant speech before the signing, insisting the rumors of terrors are ephemeral.
timeline.quote: Today's speech was beautiful.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Udaen reports that Thoros's kin have gathered a small army of several hundred men from the settlements.
timeline.quote: Thoros's brothers and sons had gathered a small army of several hundred men from the settlements.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kedarick believes his secret means Klytessa and Lara are returning, and looks to a new age for Iretis.
timeline.quote: You are coming back. You are coming back!

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax, invisible in the throne room, watches the king of Iretis stab out both his own eyes after hearing of the murder of his wife and child.
timeline.quote: It was the second stab into his other eye, the mortal shrieking all the while, that Phenax found so impressive.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The old man's illusion fades and reveals Ashiok.
timeline.quote: the old man's form began to waver and shimmer.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reads the king's letters and saves them from the fire.
timeline.quote: Ashiok held the letters above the fire for a second, then stopped and brought them back, undamaged, to lay on the desk.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax confronts Ashiok about the deaths; Ashiok admits the story was invented but the family may die on the road.
timeline.quote: The story of their deaths I made up.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax warns Ashiok to show respect.
timeline.quote: Presume with me again, and I will erase you from existence.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the leonin are sacking Iretis and that the city now belongs to Phenax.
timeline.quote: The leonin sacking of the city has already begun.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax asks Ashiok what boon is wanted; Ashiok reveals a love of making nightmares real.
timeline.quote: I have built a beautiful dream here in Iretis.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok whispers a request to Phenax, who is surprised.
timeline.quote: You are sure, mortal? This is what you want?

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax looks into Ashiok's essence, laughs, grants the wish and leaves.
timeline.quote: So be it, mortal. You shall have your wish.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
timeline.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
timeline.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kedarick sends his advisor Udaen, secretly Ashiok, to broker the peace treaty.
timeline.quote: Kedarick sent his advisor Udaen to broker the treaty

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thoros offers support for peace, then pulls his nephew's head from his satchel blaming the leonin, and lunges at Kedarick; Kedarick beheads him.
timeline.quote: Thoros himself was beheaded by Kedarick, his former friend.

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A leonin army marches on Iretis; Ashiok falsely tells Kedarick his wife and child were murdered, and Kedarick stabs out his own eyes.
timeline.quote: Kedarick drew his dagger and stabbed himself first in one eye, then the other

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals themself as mastermind; Phenax claims Iretis for his Returned.
timeline.quote: Phenax would have the city to house his Returned

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
